title: Europe's Extreme Heat Wave Crisis Is Getting Worse
title_cn: 欧洲的极端热浪危机正在变得更加严重

Climate change is increasing the frequency and intensity of extreme heat on the world's fastest-warming continent, straining power grids, sapping water supplies and curbing farm output. Our Weather and Climate Reporter Joe Wertz joined Stephen Carroll and Tiwa Adebayo on Bloomberg Radio to discuss.  (Source: Bloomberg)
